messages: sara: Opening POC scoping for Meridian pilot. Need success criteria, integration approach (mobile SDK vs REST), auth, quota defaults, streaming choices, and security notes. lee: They want a 7-business-day pilot, soft spend cap $4k. Primary use: in-app assistant + knowledge retrieval. ben: For assistant UX streaming is preferred. Mobile SDK supports reconnects; fallback is chunked HTTP streaming. sara: Draft success criteria: 1) 95th pct streaming latency < 300ms, 2) accuracy >= 90% on their 120 prompt eval, 3) avg cost <= $0.40 per 1k tokens. lee: Customer okay with those but asks for billing pause at 75% cap. ben: We can configure Console alerts + webhook to their ops. Auth: propose per-key scoping (client vs server keys). KMS/HSM only if they move to Dedicated. infra-bot: Suggest pilot quotas: 90 reqs/min, 20 concurrent streams, 7k tokens/min (soft). sara: Retry policy: backoff 300ms -> 700ms -> 1.5s, max 3 retries; respect Retry-After; idempotency keys for non-chat. ben: I'll send minimal JS streaming snippet and curl fallback. billing-bot: Billing alert webhooks can be created; please provide webhook URL and threshold. sara: Next steps: Lee collects 120 prompts + scoring script; Ben sends SDK snippets and retry config; Sara writes one-pager success criteria + timeline. lee: I'll get prompts today and confirm webhook URL. sara: Thanks — I'll share the one-pager by EOD tomorrow.
